correctness.rationale: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py: n=6 replay VERIFY_OK over 22 rows, n=7 over 45 rows, n=8 over 88 rows, ALL VERIFY_OK, global max gap (5 at n=8 (4,3,1)x(4,2,2), Sm=201600=5*8!). Independently re-derived all 155 rows with a third from-scratch Murnaghan-Nakayama implementation (different validity-logic order): hook-length dims match character-at-identity, sum dim^2 = n! (720/5040/40320), all (g,m) class sums exactly divisible by n! with (g+m),(g-m) even and s,a>=0, s+a=g. Headline values confirmed: g=7/m=5 at ((4,3,1),(4,2,2)); per-degree maxima 3 at ((3,2,1),(4,2))=(3,0,3) and 4 at ((4,2,1),(5,2))=(4,0,4); staircase (3,2,1)^2 row reproduced exactly (all g>=1, all s>=1). Scope correction verified: length-3 partitions at n=6/7/8 are 3/4/5, of which (4,1,1),(5,1,1),(6,1,1) are hooks (second row 1) correctly excluded, so true family is 2+3+4=9 squares / 155 rows, not the brief's 10/177. Uniqueness of family maximum verified by exhaustive scan (one attainer). Degree identities sum g*dim=d^2, sum s*dim=d(d+1)/2, sum a*dim=d(d-1)/2 asserted in compute.py; row/column orthogonality and transpose symmetry checked in verify.py and re-confirmed. No proof-vs-evidence confusion: claim is a certified finite computation, presented as such.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: (i) Meszaros-Wolosz arXiv:1909.07489 determines symmetric/exterior squares only for hooks; candidate excludes every hook by definition (exactly 3 rows, second row>=2), so zero overlap. (ii) Bessenrodt-Bowman arXiv:2202.03066 full text (HTML v3) checked: Sec 4 solves hook squares; Thm 5.2 gives only depth<=2 constituents; Prop 5.4 gives squares of depth<=2 characters; Thm 5.5 gives the [n-3,3] square with [n-3,2,1]-type explicitly left as 'much more involved' (unsolved); Sec 7 (Thms 7.8/7.11/7.13) solves only 2-part squares [k,k],[k+1,k],[k+1,k-1]. All 9 candidate lambdas have depth>=3 and 3 rows, outside every solved regime. (iii) Pak-Panova-Vallejo arXiv:1304.0738 proves only unsplit g>0 for hooks/two-rows with no symmetric/alternating refinement; g alone does not imply (s,a), which needs the independent w->w^2 power-map summand certified row by row. (iv) Zhao arXiv:2309.00764 studies unsplit positivity for squares of square shapes (m^m), a different lambda-family, not splitting of three-row squares. (v) Internal prior scan: closest validated findings are two-row splitting census S7/S8 (SCOPE024), staircase n=10 plus global all-pairs gaps n=8-12 (SCOPE017), and unsplit atlas to n=10 (SCOPE058) — materially different shape families/refinements. No source publishes the (s,a,g) table or family maximal |s-a| witness for this family.

value.rationale: Headline result judged separately from any survey: the complete exact (s,a,g,m) splitting census for the 9 non-hook three-row squares at n=6..8 (155 rows), with unique family maximal gap G*=5 at ((4,3,1),(4,2,2))=(6,1,7,5) and the staircase (3,2,1) refined-Saxl row (all 11 irreps present with s>=1 throughout). Object and invariant were motivated before computation: Bessenrodt-Bowman abstract/intro establishes symmetric/alternating splitting as scarce and motivates it via refined-Saxl Conjecture C (Sec 10), 2-modular decomposition links, multiplicity-free classification (Thms 9.3/9.4), and Catalan combinatorics; non-hook three-rows are the minimal family outside all solved regimes (hooks, 2-parts, small depth) with only unsplit positivity known. Values were not known or mechanically implied: no cited closed formula decides them and g-values alone do not determine the power-map summand m. A future researcher testing refined-Saxl Conjecture C, 2-modular relations, or splitting routines could reasonably need these precise points (e.g. the 201600=5*8! certificate, per-degree maxima 3/4/5, staircase symmetric-containment row). The census is complete for its stated family (the brief's 10/177 miscount is honestly corrected to 9/155 with the hook reason given); maximality is honestly scoped to the family, not global over S8. This is a narrow exact datum of the kind the standard explicitly allows, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration.

decisive_checks: Re-ran candidate verify.py: 22+45+88 rows VERIFY_OK, global max (5, n=8 (4,3,1)x(4,2,2), (6,1,7,5)), Sm=201600=5*8!.
Third independent MN recomputation (different recursion/validity order) reproduced all 155 (g,m) with exact divisibility, parity, nonnegativity, and headline values (7,5), (3,3), (4,4).
Exhaustive partition enumeration confirmed family completeness: 2+3+4=9 non-hook three-rows; (4,1,1),(5,1,1),(6,1,1) are hooks correctly excluded; brief 10/177 corrected to 9/155.
Exhaustive scan confirmed uniqueness of family maximum |s-a|=5 and per-degree maxima 3 (n=6) and 4 (n=7) with stated attainers.
Staircase (3,2,1)^2 row reproduced exactly: all 11 g>=1 and all 11 s>=1 with the 11 listed (s,a,g) triples.
Full-text check of Bessenrodt-Bowman Secs 4/5/7 confirmed no closed (s,a) formula covers depth>=3 three-row squares.
residual_risks: No GAP/Sage cross-check available in this environment (gap not installed); mitigation is two independent MN implementations plus column orthogonality, transpose symmetry, hook-dimension, and degree-identity checks, all passing.
Literature search relied on arXiv abstract/full-text (HTML v3) plus admission record; a formally published extension of BB Sec 5/7 beyond v3 is unlikely but cannot be logically excluded.
Downstream uses (2-modular, multiplicity-free, Catalan) are conjectural and correctly labeled as such; value rests on the data being reusable test points, not on derived consequences.
